papa.label: Papa's book
papa.subject: papa news reads Bloomberg, the FT and The Edge Singapore in full, not just their headlines. A page a plain request is refused is asked again through curl_cffi (Python), which makes the TLS handshake a browser's: these sites block on the handshake, not the user-agent. Bloomberg's page carries the whole story in __NEXT_DATA__ (read by bloombergStory); the FT needs Safari's handshake and Google as referrer; The Edge's premium pieces are cut to their opening on its server, kept and labelled as an opening. The three never fall back to the free reader (it handed back Bloomberg's teaser as the article), and reads to them go one at a time, 3 s apart, after Bloomberg blocked the home address following ~8 quick reads. Live, laptop: 12/12 Bloomberg (incl. Google-found Thailand links), 6/6 FT, Edge news whole and premium as opening; Pi, in the papa-news sandbox: 8 Bloomberg and 6/6 FT before Bloomberg's block. Unit 539/539; mutants (quotes dropped, Edge access ignored, reader allowed for the walled three) red. Pi venv /opt/papa-fetch-venv; note papa-news-walled-sites. Asked: "im fine with working around paywalls and bot checks as its a private app. 1. is fine. any methods is fine. i do not want to only read title tbh".

weight.label: Weight
weight.subject: Weight: steps and calories burnt from Samsung Health, shown only when connected. Health.java also asks Health Connect for steps, active and total calories burnt and hands each of the last 30 days' totals (Health Connect's own sums, so phone and watch steps are not counted twice). The Food page's day gets a steps tile and a "kcal burnt moving" tile (the total burnt for someone with no active figure); Week / Month / Year get Steps a day and kcal burnt a day against the period before, where more is blue. Only while Health Connect allows them, and only for the phone's owner (Mummy's page on this phone shows none). Settings › Samsung Health offers Connect steps and calories until allowed. Every day goes on the sheet's new Steps tab, written over as the day's figures grow, and a new phone reads old days back. test/moves.test.mjs (4 mutants red), e2e 9g (321 checks; mutants red: more steps shown orange, shown while not connected, shown on someone else's page); Java compiles against android-34.
